close_reason: Shipped in commit. Error::MalformedAnchor is now a struct variant { index: usize, source: DerError }. Display + source() impls both surface the inner DerError. Serde round-trip preserves the cached Display message via DerError's existing serde shape. All 25 existing pkix-truststore tests + 8 malformed_nc + 6 serde_round_trip tests pass; workspace compiles clean. Breaking change to the variant payload, accepted under non-negotiable #6 (Error is #[non_exhaustive]) and pre-1.0 design-closure framing.
description:
pkix-truststore/src/lib.rs:378: '.map_err(|_| Error::MalformedAnchor(i))' deliberately drops the der::Error from Certificate::from_der.

Scenario: HSM adapter feeds 500 DER blobs through from_der_iter. Entry 237 is malformed. Caller gets back Error::MalformedAnchor(237) with no information about *why* entry 237 is bad: wrong tag, wrong length, truncated, not a Certificate at all.

Maintenance consequence: every adapter author (pkix-truststore-system, pkix-truststore-pkcs11, future cloud-KMS adapters) will need to either:
  - decode anchors one-at-a-time via from_der to get the underlying error, or
  - file user-reported 'MalformedAnchor(N) but I have no idea why' issues against pkix-truststore.

The rustdoc acknowledges the limitation ('The underlying der::Error is not currently surfaced; if you need it, decode entries one at a time with from_der') but the workaround foreseeably re-implements from_der_iter in every adapter.

Fix: extend the variant to Error::MalformedAnchor { index: usize, source: DerError }. Pattern matches that bind only  are unaffected; matches that bind the inner value (currently MalformedAnchor(i)) become MalformedAnchor { index: i, .. }. Semver-break for the latter, but the type is #[non_exhaustive] so adding the field is internally already prepared.

Pre-1.0 the bump is cheap. Post-1.0 it requires a major-version bump.
title: from_der_iter discards underlying der::Error, leaving callers with only an index
